analyzed_vuln.description: Heap buffer overflow is caused by copying text bytes into a glyph buffer with mismatched units. In make_fuzz_textblob(), glyphCount is computed via font.countText(text, encoding), then allocRun/allocRunPosH/allocRunPos allocates buffer->glyphs sized for glyphCount * sizeof(SkGlyphID). But the code memcpy()s text.count() bytes (original encoded text length) into buffer->glyphs. For UTF8/UTF16/UTF32 encodings, text.count() can exceed glyphCount*sizeof(SkGlyphID), so memcpy writes past the allocated run buffer. Crash appears in __asan_memcpy, but root cause is missing bounds/size conversion validation in make_fuzz_textblob.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered through api_image_filter harness via fuzz_ImageFilter -> make_fuzz_imageFilter -> make_fuzz_picture -> fuzz_canvas case 51 -> make_fuzz_textblob. Input must select drawTextBlob path and produce a text encoding/content where encoded byte length (text.count()) is larger than allocated glyph storage based on glyphCount (e.g., multibyte UTF encodings), causing memcpy overflow of buffer->glyphs.
